## Object affected

Which object? e.g. Paper Clip (`/archive/paper-clip`)

## Existing information

What the archive currently says. Quote it or link it.

## Correct information

What it should say instead.

## Evidence / source

Provide the source that supports the correction. Links are preferred.

## Explanation

A short note on why the original information is wrong or uncertain. If the
historical record is genuinely contested, describe both sides — the archive
prefers honest uncertainty over confident error.

- [ ] I confirm this correction is based on a credible source
